reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage as a cryptocurrency earning opportunity with a direct referral route, a stated 0.05 ETH payment, and claims of X3/X4 commissions, reinvestment, and potentially unlimited referral-based income. It reinforces the investment framing with an Rs. 3000 earning claim and instructs viewers to contact an on-screen number, while an opening disclaimer limits responsibility.

citations.quote: There are two types of earnings in this. One is X3 and the other X4.
X3 is the income which you get through direct refer
x4 is the income which you get through you teammates
only if your mates are higher, you will get passive income
To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.

opening.argument: Judge, this presentation should be read as a disclosed commercial promotion, not a promise that joining will pay off. The description says joining is a matter of personal choice and identifies the video as a commercial collaboration [1]. An opening disclaimer also cautions that the channel does not warrant the accuracy or completeness of its information [2]. Those qualifications do not prove Forsage is safe, but they matter to whether the speaker is presenting an assured outcome. The stated 0.05 ETH is a cost to join [3]; a stated cost, even alongside an earning opportunity, does not by itself establish that viewers are guaranteed a return.

citations.quote: Joining the Forsage Platform is one's own wish.. This video is for commercial collaboration only.
To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly quotes the X3 and X4 descriptions, but those lines describe where the speaker says income comes from; they do not document any viewer receiving it [1][2]. Nor does the joining price establish a promised profit [3]. The disclosure of commercial collaboration and personal choice is context the prosecution's account leaves out [4]. A persuasive pitch warrants scrutiny, but the quoted terms alone do not turn its claims into a guaranteed outcome.

citations.quote: X3 is the income which you get through direct refer
x4 is the income which you get through you teammates
To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.
Joining the Forsage Platform is one's own wish.. This video is for commercial collaboration only.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer does not undo the solicitation. The description immediately invites viewers to join using a referral [1], and the speaker says joining costs 0.05 ETH [2]. More importantly, the pitch identifies direct referrals and teammates as the sources of X3 and X4 income [3]. The defense is right that these are not verified payouts; that is not what establishes the concern. It is the promotion of paid entry into a participant-dependent earning structure.

citations.quote: Join forsage using the referral ...
To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.
X3 is the income which you get through direct refer x4 is the income which you get through you teammates

opening.argument: Judge, there is a substantial explanatory thread here. The speaker begins by introducing cryptocurrency as digital currency and naming Bitcoin [1], then discusses purchasing coins in varying amounts [2]. The narration turns to Ethereum and blockchain while saying viewers will learn how cryptocurrency investment works [3]. When Forsage comes up, X3 and X4 are distinguished as two ways the platform says earnings work [4]. Explaining a mechanism is not the same as proving that it pays or that the speaker has obtained the advertised results. The material can reasonably be treated as an operational explanation containing commercial material, rather than reducing the whole video to a solicitation.

The coin can be purchased any amount you want.
We are going to learn how to invest what it is like to work in the cryptocurrency sector. Ethereum is created in blockchain technology.
There are two types of earnings in this. One is X3 and the other X4.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution isolates the joining price and the X3/X4 lines, but describing a platform's entry requirement and distinguishing its two named mechanisms are also things an explanatory walkthrough would do [1][2]. The narration expressly introduces the subject as something viewers are going to learn about [3]. The cited statements establish what the speaker says the mechanisms are; they do not establish that the video demonstrates a successful payout.

citations.quote: To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.
There are two types of earnings in this. One is X3 and the other X4.
We are going to learn how to invest what it is like to work in the cryptocurrency sector.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The introductory cryptocurrency explanation does not make the later pitch merely educational. The description tells viewers to join through a referral [1], the speaker directs interested viewers to make contact [2], and the earning explanation ties income to direct referrals and teammates [3]. No verified payout is needed to identify what is being promoted: a paid, recruitment-linked earning opportunity.

citations.quote: Join forsage using the referral ...
If you want to join in it Please call or message the number on the screen
X3 is the income which you get through direct refer x4 is the income which you get through you teammates

opening.argument: Judge, the more precise reading is a referral promotion for a service whose results are unverified, not proof that its depicted earnings were obtained. The description openly presents a referral route [1], and the speaker states the cost of joining rather than concealing it [2]. The X3 and X4 descriptions identify direct referrals and teammates as claimed income sources [3]. That is a reason to be cautious, but these cited statements do not show an actual payout, a guaranteed return, or what happens to any particular viewer's payment. The speaker also characterizes the arrangement as funds going to members [4]. That characterization may be disputed; it should not be silently treated as either verified fact or proof of an undisclosed outcome.

citations.quote: Join forsage using the referral ...

X3 is the income which you get through direct refer x4 is the income which you get through you teammates
That means the money invested in it goes to its members only.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's strongest point is that the named earning routes depend on referrals and teammates [1]. But its quoted 0.05 ETH figure is an entry price, not evidence that anyone received a return [2]. The visible X4 diagram illustrates a proposed commission flow; it cannot verify an actual transfer [3]. This supports close scrutiny of the offer, while leaving its real-world outcomes unestablished.

citations.quote: X3 is the income which you get through direct refer x4 is the income which you get through you teammates
To join Forsage you need to pay 0.05E, which also includes the network charge.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing payout evidence is beside the central point. The video says people must pay to join [1], explicitly links X3 and X4 income to direct referrals and teammates [2], and displays a commission-and-reinvestment matrix [3]. It also invites joining through a referral [4]. Calling this an ordinary referral promotion overlooks that the promoted earning mechanism itself is tied to bringing other participants into the paid structure.
